integrity: The finite coefficient search is exhaustive by rank and exact arithmetic, all computational sources and output evidence are provided. A Walsh calculation independently checks incidence aggregation but depends on the smooth-mask list. Affine Groebner tests independently corroborate smoothness on 78 positive projective orbits; they do not repeat the full negative enumeration. Historical-priority equivalence cannot be excluded categorically.
limitations: Counts concern linear two-dimensional subspaces of homogeneous ternary quartics over F_2 and their PGL_3(F_2) orbits; they are not counts of abstract isomorphism classes of member curves. Rational base points do not determine geometric base-scheme multiplicities. Existence or classification in other degrees and fields is not asserted.
title: Exact projective and rational-base census of smooth binary plane-quartic pencils
